faqs.question: What age groups do you teach?
faqs.answer: We work with children from ages 6 to 18 across all our programs. Each program has age-specific tracks so your child learns alongside peers at the same developmental stage.

faqs.question: Does my child need any prior experience?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is needed for any of our programs. We begin every child at the right starting point based on a brief assessment, and our instructors are trained to make concepts approachable from day one.

faqs.question: Are classes online, in-person, or both?
faqs.answer: We offer both live online classes and in-person sessions at partner schools across Nairobi. Corporate and school partnership programs are delivered on-site.

faqs.question: What does my child receive at the end?
faqs.answer: Every student receives a verified certificate of completion, a portfolio of real projects they built during the program, and access to our alumni network. These are meaningful credentials — not participation trophies.

faqs.question: How do school partnerships work?
faqs.answer: We work with school administration to schedule technology programs that run alongside the existing curriculum. Our team handles everything — equipment, curriculum, instructors, and progress reports — with minimal disruption to your school's timetable.

faqs.question: How much do the programs cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing varies by program length and delivery mode. Contact us directly and we'll give you a clear breakdown with no surprises. We also have partnership pricing for schools enrolling multiple students.
